# Copilot Instructions

The guide for coding agents in this repository is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the root. Read it before suggesting or changing code. It lists the module's rules and links to the detailed guides in [docs/development/](../docs/development/).

Edit `AGENTS.md`, not this file. This file only points Copilot features that do not read `AGENTS.md` to it.
